chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Washa, from al-Mithammi, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not place the bread beneath the bowl.'
ai.seo_question: What is the etiquette regarding placing bread under the bowl while eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs against placing the bread directly under the bowl, a practical guideline in Shia fiqh that emphasizes both physical cleanliness (taharah) and the etiquette of consuming food with dignity. This narration, found in al-Kafi, reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on avoiding waste and maintaining hygiene during meals, aligning with the Prophetic tradition of eating from what is directly in front of one. The ruling underscores the integration of daily habits with spiritual mindfulness, ensuring that even mundane acts like eating are performed with awareness of divine guidelines.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Al Maysami, from Aban Bin Taghlub who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not place the bread beneath the bowl’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from al-Mithamiy from Aban ibn Taghlib who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A loaf of bread must not be placed under the dish.”
